t: Estate Planning Tools: Understanding Transfer on Death Instrument
s: A TODI is a document where an owner of real estate can designate a beneficiary (or beneficiaries) to receive that real estate at the time of the owner’s death. Analogous to this concept is the beneficiary of a life insurance policy: when the insured on a life insurance policy dies, the beneficiary receives the life insurance death benefit.
